opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt/excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Not eligible: individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities/councils. Only one application at a time; must wait a year after a previous decision.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open all year round with no deadlines for submission. Grants typically support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget (operating/core costs), approximately 10-20% of capital costs (with local community projects capped at £30,000), and around 10-20% of project costs. Multi-year grants available over two or three years.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations. For capital/project costs, total project cost must be at least £1 million. For core costs, organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. For capital/project costs the total project cost must be at least £1 million (regardless of organisation's annual income); for core costs the organisation's annual income must be at least £1 million. Expressions of Interest can be submitted all year round with no deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis. Local community capital projects (e.g. churches, village halls) are advised to apply for a regular grant instead.
